title: Stick to spending limits, PM and chancellor tell ministers in joint memo
summary: The UK Chancellor and Prime Minister jointly instructed government ministers to adhere to spending limits ahead of the October 28 Budget. The guidance emphasizes that the Budget will "meet our fiscal rules" and provide economic stability for households planning ahead.
content: The Chancellor said the Budget on 28 October would “meet our fiscal rules” and give families "stability" to plan for the future.

zh.title: 首相与财政大臣联合备忘录要求部长遵守支出限制
zh.summary: 英国财政大臣和首相联合指示政府部长在10月28日预算案前遵守支出限制。该指导强调预算案将"符合我们的财政规则"，并为计划未来的家庭提供经济稳定。

title: Building for 131°F: Europe races to protect its infrastructure from a ‘quiet catastrophe’
summary: Extreme summer weather has triggered severe infrastructure stress across Europe, prompting a coordinated response from companies and policymakers. The region is racing to protect critical systems against rising temperatures, with many projects now designed to withstand 131°F heat.
content: A summer of weather extremes and severe infrastructure stress has prompted companies and policymakers across Europe to respond.

zh.title: 为131°F而建：欧洲争相保护其基础设施免受"静悄悄的灾难"
zh.summary: 极端的夏季天气在整个欧洲引发了严重的基础设施压力，促使企业和政策制定者做出协调应对。该地区正在争先恐后地保护关键系统免受气温上升的影响，许多项目现已设计为能够承受131°F的高温。

title: Iran's overlapping power centers make ending the war more complicated
summary: Iran's complex power structure, including the Supreme Leader and Revolutionary Guards, complicates any potential ceasefire negotiations. The overlapping centers of authority make it difficult to enforce diplomatic agreements with the U.S.
content: Iran’s power structure complicates efforts to enforce any ceasefire with the U.S., from the Supreme Leader to the Revolutionary Guards.

zh.title: 伊朗重叠的权力中心使结束战争变得更加复杂
zh.summary: 伊朗复杂的权力结构，包括最高领导人和伊斯兰革命卫队，使任何潜在的停火谈判都变得复杂。权力中心的重叠使得难以执行与美国的外交协议。

title: My ex-husband’s sister died — so why is Fidelity asking me for her death certificate?
summary: Fidelity is requesting a death certificate from a woman regarding her ex-husband's sister, highlighting the bureaucratic friction and costs involved in financial estate processes. The article explores the absurdity of these requirements for non-direct beneficiaries.
content: “Part of me jokes that paying for a death certificate would be like buying a lottery ticket.”

zh.title: 我的前夫姐姐去世了——为什么富达要求我提供她的死亡证明？
zh.summary: 富达要求一位女性提供其前夫姐姐的死亡证明，突显了金融遗产处理过程中的官僚摩擦和成本。该文章探讨了对非直接受益人提出这些要求的荒谬性。

title: Soccer-FIFA scraps World Cup sell-off plan after resistance from members
summary: FIFA has abandoned its proposal to sell a stake in its business to outside investors after fierce resistance from member associations. The decision reflects concerns from member organizations about maintaining control over the organization.
content: FIFA said on Friday it will not proceed with its proposal to sell a piece of its business empire to outside investors after the project was met with fierce resistance from some of its member associations.

zh.title: 足球-国际足联在成员反对后放弃世界杯股权出售计划
zh.summary: 国际足联在成员协会的强烈反对下放弃了将其部分业务股权出售给外部投资者的提议。该决定反映了成员组织对维持对该组织控制权的担忧。
